title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Credit Memorandum: Lifetime Hardship Room and Payment Tenure
content:
**Memorandum.** For a hardship request on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the lifetime room of the hardship offer is the plan's lifetime maximum plus a tenure extension, less the months already deferred: whole scheduled payments covered net of returned payments of at least the long-tenure count of 36 add the tenure extension of 2 months; fewer than the short-tenure count of 12 take the short-tenure cut of 1 month off; any other count changes nothing.

**Counting whole scheduled payments.** Whole scheduled payments are counted against the scheduled monthly payment, which is the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 times the financed amount, rounded to the cent and not below the plan's minimum monthly payment. The money posted as scheduled-payment entries, less the money of payments returned unpaid, is divided by that scheduled monthly payment and rounded down to a whole number. Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

## Tenure extension

| Whole scheduled payments covered | Effect on the plan's lifetime maximum |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | Plus 2 months (tenure extension) |
| 12 to 35 | No change |
| 11 or fewer | Less 1 month (short-tenure cut) |

## Boundary cases

- 36 covered: plus 2 months; 35 covered: no change.
- 12 covered: no change; 11 covered: less 1 month.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Scheduled monthly payment 150.00; scheduled-payment entries total 5550.00; no returned payments. 5550.00 divided by 150.00 is 37, so 2 months are added: with a hypothetical lifetime maximum of 5 and 1 month already deferred, the lifetime room is 5 plus 2, less 1, or 6.
